use.reason: Apply it to the two labelled embeddings of the same F. This conjugates the actual homomorphisms, rather than merely their unlabelled images. It is exactly the rational conjugacy at CJproof41. Locally it lets the unramified quadratic field in the division-algebra model be identified with the given embedded F_q. The official August5,2026 erratum corrects the unit-group notation after separable scalar extension and deletes the optional splitting-field parenthesis; neither uncorrected step is used.

assertion.statement: For a simple subalgebra A of a central simple algebra B, dim(B)=dim(A)*dim(C_B(A)).

assertion.quantifiers: Every object satisfying precisely the stated source hypotheses.

assertion.uniformity: Exact existence, identity or classification only; no quantitative estimate.
assertion.constants: Dimensions4 and2 where used; valuation factor1/2 in the local division case.
assertion.normalizations: Do not use uncorrected Corollary7.7.11; the dimension formula itself gives the needed centralizer.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Do not use uncorrected Corollary7.7.11; the dimension formula itself gives the needed centralizer.
assertion.limit_order: No limits. Apply the source theorem before the following finite algebraic calculation.

use.reason: Take k=Q and A=F. The dimensions are4 and2, so the centralizer has dimension2. It contains F, hence equals F. Its invertible elements are therefore F-times. This is the pointwise stabilizer in CJproof41–44; the larger normalizer, which can exchange the two embeddings, is not substituted. Corollary7.7.11 is not needed.
